title: Disclosure-stabilization strain: long fast-stabilizing filers, short slow-stabilizing filers (first-to-last vintage span of the same period), per-sector net-zero on the death-inclusive cohort — a process mechanism that never reads what the numbers changed to

mechanism.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: The certifying officers and auditor are the FORCED actor again, but on the process margin: every resubmission of a period re-opens the Section 302/906 certification chain, so an entity whose certified numbers keep being resubmitted long after the period ended is an entity whose reporting process cannot converge — internal-control weakness, management-auditor contention, or repeated discovery of deficiencies. The slow-to-react actor is the market: a stabilization 'span' has no event day at all (no filing headline is attached to a duration), so the process-quality signal is never impounded as news and discounts accrue gradually.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: Vintage-span length is a disclosure-process-quality signal: values that stabilize within weeks certify a convergent reporting process; values still being resubmitted a year or two later certify the opposite (internal-control-weakness lineage: weak-IC firms exhibit poorer earnings quality, more misstatement risk, and higher cost of capital, which shows up as persistent underperformance rather than a single repricing). The effect is about HOW the machinery behaved, not WHAT the corrected numbers said: the information is carried by re-submission cadence and duration even before one reads the direction of any correction. A death-inclusive cohort is required for honest measurement: chronic slow stabilizers are disproportionately names that later die, so a survivor-only panel censors the short leg exactly where the process-quality penalty realizes.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: inter_arrival_days on the V10-R4 clock (the first-to-last vintage stamp span of a filer-field-period group) averaged over the entity's most-recent as-of-t field-period groups; supporting leg from amend_count on V10-R3 (re-submission count intensity). This is a process/velocity construct: rev_mag NEVER enters any arm of this family, and rev_dir enters only the control's value-flat filter — declared so the family remains mechanistically distinct from SFV10-A5-H1 (sign content), which trades rev_dir/rev_mag.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) stabilization span carries no forward information on this cohort: anchor expectancy <= 0 after band costs; (ii) the value-flat control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign alpha — then the signal is an issuer EDGAR-workflow/administrative-refiling trait (including comparative-repetition tenure), not correction-process strain, and the family dies; (iii) fewer than 2 of 3 folds positive or drop-one expectancy <= 0; (iv) the pre-selection identifiability or novelty gates declared below fail — the proposal dies at D2 before any scored cell. Declared confound, testable by the control: span partially embeds reporting tenure (later periodic filings repeat prior-period comparatives, deepening vintages); the mechanism claim is that the strain variation around that repetition — periods whose values had to be re-submitted repeatedly before stabilizing — carries the discount, and the value-flat control is exactly the test of that claim.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: The convenient explanation is 'some issuers just refile a lot — amendments are administrative EDGAR housekeeping with zero information'. The value-flat control kills it: the identical span machinery computed ONLY over groups whose value never changed between first and last vintage (rev_dir = 0 — administrative re-submissions and comparative repetition). If administrative re-filing span reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign, the information is who-refiles (an issuer trait), not whose-numbers-would-not-stabilize (a process-quality event) — the family is falsified. It genuinely discriminates because the two arms coincide only on entities with no value-changing groups and diverge exactly on the correction-bearing population that the mechanism says carries the signal.

falsifiable_prediction: Within-sector stabilization span predicts next-quarter relative returns: the slow-stabilizing tercile (short) underperforms the fast-stabilizing tercile (long) in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 after band costs, with (a) anchor expectancy > 0; (b) position PF >= 1.1; (c) risk-matched SPY-excess positive in >= 2 folds and overall alpha > 0; (d) mapped sector-ETF factor positive share <= 0.35; (e) the value-flat control's |alpha| < 0.5x the anchor's alpha — same-sign reproduction at >= 0.5x kills the family; (f) the re-submission-velocity neighbour supports with same-sign alpha; (g) pooled Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs all nine veto entries, measured before selection. Failure interpretations preregistered: (e) firing means administrative re-filing trait — withdraw the process-strain claim; (a) failing means stabilization behavior is already priced or uninformative on this cohort; (f) sign-flipping means count-intensity and duration disagree about strain — withdraw the single-construct reading. Availability-lag mutation (P3 invariant): pushing any vintage stamp later shifts observable_available_at and the span by exactly that amount and no more than one decision-grid step; any larger shift is an implementation leak and the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed.

universe.bookable_pool: ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410) + DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550) legs of research/control/stocks_free_v9_run/cohort_v9.json (sha 6a95401f...) carried unchanged; GAP_COVERAGE (513) and NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL (219) excluded-with-reasons and recorded; never bookable in any arm; no survivorship re-substitution.
universe.eligibility_per_decision: bookable pool AND >= 63 price bars through the decision date (inherited floor) AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; UNTRADABLE excluded, L-I3 fail-closed) AND RAW close >= 1.00 USD AND |Q(e,t)| >= 4 qualifying field-period groups (P0-frozen min_hist floor of 4, reused; not tuned) AND the entity's frozen sector tag has >= 6 eligible ranked names, else that sector abstains the decision.
universe.sector_conditioning: frozen empirical SIC-to-SPDR majority map shipped in cohort_v9.json (sic_sector_map), carried unchanged per plan.

cited_funded_clocks.use: CONTROL ONLY — identifies value-flat groups (rev_dir = 0) for the administrative-refiling placebo; never enters the anchor or neighbour

clock.conditioning_rule: a decision at session t observes a group only if observable_available_at (= last_avail) < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; staleness bound 0 <= t - observable_available_at <= 800 days; no contemporaneous inputs; conditioning always on last_avail (P2 clock_semantics); deadline-distance never cited (DATA_BLOCKED_VALID, P2 not_funded); no timing-family clock (V10-T1..T3) enters any arm and no timing feeder is declared — the span is a within-period vintage structure (last minus first stamp of the SAME period), not a filing-lag vs norm.
clock.per_field_basis: per field f, only the group with maximum eff among the entity's qualifying groups enters Q(e,t) — one observation per field.
clock.magnitude_disjointness_declaration: V10-R2 (rev_mag) is cited by NO arm of this family. The family reads only process observables (span, count) plus the control's flat filter — the formal boundary between this proposal and SFV10-A5-H1 (sign-content).

warmup_rationale: span and amend_count are read directly per depth>=2 group as-of the decision (no norm seeding, no delta legs; V8 F2 precedent warmup 0); the grid's index-63 start seeds ADV63; the 63-bar floor is an eligibility floor, not a signal warmup.
decision_grid: inherited 21-session grid: sessions at indices 63+21k from each fold start (k = 0,1,2,...), pure session-index schedule, no calendar anchoring; approximately 26-28 scored decisions per fold, >= 75 total (exact counts fixed before scoring). No finer grid demanded: spans evolve at filing cadence over months-to-years, so 21-session sampling cannot alias the mechanism, and the availability-lag mutation propagates stamp shifts by whole evidence stamps.

entry_exit_fills.signal_semantics: signals computed on session t close data under observable_available_at < gate(t); fills at the next allowed session close (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill).
entry_exit_fills.fill_check: verbatim from P3: a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
entry_exit_fills.exit_at_last_close: verbatim from P3: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself); exit costing via resolve_exit_band_bps — C-rate ceiling when the band is UNTRADABLE/missing, never the silent fallback (L-I3 kernel).
entry_exit_fills.holding: one grid step (21 trading sessions) with rank-hysteresis: a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile; book forced flat at every fold boundary.
entry_exit_fills.portfolio_construction: per-sector net-zero long-short: within each sector tag with >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the bottom tercile and short the top tercile of the exposure (descending = short), equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9. Ties at tercile boundaries join the lower (long) tercile — deterministic, conservative.

costs.model: inherited band model, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL, no sidecar: research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py verbatim — BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of: ADV63 >= 50,000,000 -> A, >= 10,000,000 -> B, >= 2,000,000 -> C, else UNTRADABLE; fill_cost_bps = abs(dw) * resolve_band_bps(name, bands) * cost_mult / 10_000.0.
costs.fail_closed: a traded name without a computed band at costing raises BandResolutionError — the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden (L-I3); exits use resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing; entries never use that path).
costs.stress: stress rerun is cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) applied to booked PnL; reported alongside base.
costs.expected_blend: dead leg skews low-ADV; blended base expected between 15 and 25 bps per side; fills, cost and booked PnL reported split by band for base AND stress.

arms.arms_note: exactly three arms per binding rule; all arms RUN under evidenced semantics (P-3): every input row is a staged depth>=2 vintage group with recorded last_avail; no asserted timestamps (P-1); each arm is testable under the P3 availability-lag mutation.
arms.anchor: stabilization span: exposure span(e,t) (formula in exposure_definition), per-sector long-low/short-high terciles. Claim: disclosures that need long first-to-last vintage windows to stabilize mark process-quality weakness whose discount accrues gradually.
arms.neighbour_mechanism: re-submission velocity: vel(e,t) = 365.25 * (sum of amend_count over Q(e,t) / |Q(e,t)|) / max(span(e,t), 1) — amendments per year — under V10-R3 + V10-R4; same long-low/short-high convention (higher velocity = more strained = short). Required SUPPORT with same-sign alpha: both arms measure re-submission burden (anchor from the duration side, neighbour from the count side); a sign disagreement means duration and count tell opposite stories and the single strain-construct reading is withdrawn (declared support-failure interpretation, not a tuning opportunity).
arms.causal_placebo_control: value-flat span (administrative-refiling placebo): span_flat(e,t) = mean of inter_arrival_days over Q_flat(e,t) = {(f,eff) in Q(e,t) : rev_dir = 0}, identical machinery and convention; entities with empty Q_flat are ineligible for the control (control coverage reported; R2'/R3' gates below). Under the anchor mechanism, re-submissions that never changed a value are administrative housekeeping and carry no process-quality information; kill rule: if span_flat reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign (control_alpha_abs_ratio gate), the information is who-refiles, not whose-numbers-would-not-stabilize — the family is falsified per the P3 causal_control_rule.
arms.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs value-flat control: mechanically identical on entities with no value-changing groups (they contribute equal ranks to both arms — declared) and divergent exactly on correction-bearing entities, which are the discriminating population. Declared ex-ante expectation pooled rho 0.5-0.85 against the 0.70 gate — honestly declared: if measured rho exceeds 0.70, the proposal blocks at D2 before any PnL, and that is a successful cheap kill (the V8 a5 apparatus working), not a failure of the cycle. The scoring comparison, if reached, concentrates its difference on the correction-bearing population by construction.

exposure_definition: At each decision date t (session gate g(t) = 00:00 UTC of session t), for entity e: Q(e,t) = { (f, eff) : the group (e, f, eff) exists in the staged v10_revision_observables.jsonl layer (sha 7110cbf010ae6d3f414a1a45eec1e504aff5e94464755991e98605e4795657c2), observable_available_at < g(t), 0 <= t - observable_available_at <= 800 days, and (f, eff) is the maximum-eff group of field f for e among groups satisfying the two prior conditions }. Exposure value: span(e,t) = (1/|Q(e,t)|) * sum over (f,eff) in Q(e,t) of inter_arrival_days, defined iff |Q(e,t)| >= 4; entities with |Q| < 4 are ineligible (not zero-ranked). Normalization: none (raw day-count mean used for ranking AND for the D2 veto measurement — the within-sector tercile standardization applied for trading is monotone within sector and the veto uses the raw pooled rank, the conservative choice). Ranking direction: descending span(e,t) = short side, ascending = long side. Inputs: inter_arrival_days (V10-R4) plus the two as-of conditions; rev_mag never enters; rev_dir enters only the control's Q_flat filter; no price, no level ratio, no delta-of-levels, no sign content. The same formula, evaluated on the same cohort and frozen decision dates, is what D2 ranks against each veto entry (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled).

pre_selection_identifiability_check.purpose: the V8 a5 lesson: control identifiability and anchor non-vacuity measurable BEFORE selection, from data alone, no PnL in existence.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.rule: On every frozen decision date t over S0_FOLD_1/2/3, over the pre-check universe = bookable-pool names with >= 63 price bars through t (bar counts from the sha-pinned staged price bars; NO band computation, NO returns): (R1') RANK GATE - pooled |mean Spearman rho| between the anchor rank vector and the value-flat control rank vector <= 0.70, and per-date rho <= 0.70 on >= 90% of dates (declared expectation 0.5-0.85: a measured failure blocks pre-selection and is recorded as INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE — an accepted cheap-kill outcome); (R2') CONTROL COVERAGE AND NON-DEGENERACY - Q_flat nonempty for >= 60% of the anchor's measured universe on >= 90% of dates, and both control terciles populate with >= 6 names on >= 90% of dates; (R3') COVERAGE GATE - the anchor rank is populated on >= 60% of the measured universe on >= 90% of dates; (R4') ANCHOR NON-DEGENERACY - the anchor span distribution forms both terciles with >= 6 names on >= 90% of dates (span is strictly positive for every qualifying entity, so no clean-mass tie is expected — declared contrast with H1). Any gate failure blocks the proposal BEFORE selection, fail-closed (V4 + V8 a5 precedent); the check runs at D2 alongside novelty and its bytes are published before any scored cell.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.inputs: revision observable layer under the cited clocks + staged price bar availability ONLY; no ADV, no cost model, no returns — nothing scored exists at measurement time.

incremental_alpha_test.vs_SPY: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule per P3 factor_and_benchmark), per fold and overall; require excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds and overall alpha > 0; raw PnL or long-equity beta is never accepted as alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_ETF: same test against the equal-weight mapped sector-ETF factor; the book is per-sector net zero so residual sector drift appears as reported tracking error, not alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.stage_a_gates_applied_with_no_relaxation: expectancy > 0; position PF >= 1.1; folds positive >= 2; populated-fold PF >= 0.8; max fold MDD <= 0.15; ETF positive share <= 0.35; fold positive share <= 0.5; anchor overall alpha > 0; control |alpha| ratio < 0.5; neighbour same-sign support required; margin-to-fail reported for every gate on a survivor (P-2); reproduction ALL_MATCH from a detached tree.

turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_total: >= 30 scored decision periods overall (declared grid approx. 80); >= 5 per fold.
turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected); annualized two-way with hysteresis expected below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
turnover_and_sample_floor.floor_mechanics: min 5 decision periods per fold; min 1 non-CASH leg per decision; CASH excluded from turnover, concentration and drop-one; force-flat at fold boundaries.

drop_one_design: drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival requires after-drop expectancy > 0 (dead-leg names are legitimate exclusions).
drop-one-fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival requires min > 0.

drop-one-signal-leg: recompute the anchor span as the MEDIAN over Q(e,t) instead of the mean; survival requires sign preservation and expectancy > 0; if the premium requires a few extremely slow stabilizers (tail artifact), the cross-sectional process-quality reading is withdrawn.

margin_to_fail_expectations.note: declared BEFORE any scored PnL exists, per P-2; anticipations, not thresholds — the binding thresholds are the inherited gate table and nothing here relaxes them.
margin_to_fail_expectations.expectancy_gt_0.0: MOST LIKELY BINDING GATE: 10-25 bps per side on a quarterly book whose short leg concentrates slow-stabilizing, often low-ADV names; anticipated margin small and positive if real; stress (2x) expected to consume roughly half of it.
margin_to_fail_expectations.position_pf_ge_1.1: second-most-likely binding; a process-quality discount channel is expected to produce PF in the 1.05-1.25 band if real; thin margin declared ex ante.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_and_fold_positive_sh: S0_FOLD_1 (2018-04..2020-09) declared weak: the Feb-Mar 2020 dislocation hits the fragile short side first, then partially mean-reverts inside the hysteresis window; declared risk fold-1-negative / folds-2-3-positive, passing the >= 2 gate.
margin_to_fail_expectations.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: expected to pass with margin for a per-sector net-zero book at gross <= 2.0; tail risk is death clustering on the short leg inside one sector-quarter.
margin_to_fail_expectations.etf_positive_share_le_0.35: expected to pass by construction (per-sector net zero); a fail would mean tercile legs leak sector tilt, structurally unlikely under the net-zero rule.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt_0.5: THE SPECIFICITY GATE: expected to pass if and only if correction-process strain (not administrative refiling trait) carries the spread; the R1'-R4' pre-selection gates exist precisely so this comparison is meaningful if reached, and the declared high anchor-control rank correlation is the honest statement that this gate may never be reached (pre-selection block) — which is the apparatus working.
margin_to_fail_expectations.neighbour_support: expected same-sign; a velocity sign disagreement is declared as support-failure interpretation, not a tuning opportunity.
margin_to_fail_expectations.margin_to_fail_reporting: at scoring, every gate reports its distance to the failure threshold; a survivor reporting knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% of MDD headroom) is treated as thin-margin class per P-2 regardless of pass count.

novelty_declaration.novelty_standard: measured decorrelation pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden ancestor rank and shadow, measured at D2 BEFORE selection — never prose; the exposure formula above is written so D2 can compute the rank correlation on the same cohort directly.
novelty_declaration.cross_sectional_momentum_63s_prior_retur: CLEAN BY INPUT DISJOINTNESS - no price series enters any exposure; price-derived quantities appear only in the sanctioned eligibility/cost floors. D2 gate: pooled |rho| <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.semivariance_share: CLEAN - no variance/semivariance/range quantity anywhere. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.plain_vol_level_sorting: CLEAN - no vol-level quantity anywhere. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.WC_stock_intensity: CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION - span and amend_count are filing-process observables, not AR/INV/AP levels or stocks. D2 gate <= 0.20 (measured, never argued).
novelty_declaration.Goodwill_Assets_bloat: CLEAN BY FIELD DISJOINTNESS - no Goodwill, no Assets, no level of any account enters any arm. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.F1_accrual_flow: CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION - no accrual flow composite, no delta-of-WC; the family never reads field values at all (process only). D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.depletion_runway_interaction: CLEAN - no (delta-RE, Cash, Assets) construction, no interaction form of any rejected family. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.cash_level_Cash_over_Assets: CLEAN - no cash or asset level enters any arm; if slow stabilizers correlate with cash-poor filers, the D2 measurement catches it and the proposal dies. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.sector_exposure_form: CLEAN BY DESIGN - per-sector net-zero book; sector is the neutralizer, not the exposure. D2 gate <= 0.20 on the raw exposure rank.
novelty_declaration.v10_lane_separation: NOT the filing-timing lane: no first_lag_days, own_z, cohort_z, or deadline-distance enters any arm; inter_arrival_days is the within-period vintage structure (last minus first stamp of the SAME period on the R4 clock), a revision-family observable per the P2 funding table. NOT Sloan accruals, NOT Goodwill/bloat (forbidden lineages absent by construction and by measured gate). Distinct from sibling SFV10-A5-H1 (sign-content mechanism on R1/R2 with an up-mirror control): this family is process-mechanism on R4/R3 with a value-flat control and cites R2 in no arm.

literature: Doyle, J., Ge, W., McVay, S. (2007), 'Determinants of Weaknesses in Internal Control over Financial Reporting', Journal of Accounting and Economics 44(1-2), 193-223 (firms whose reporting must be corrected repeatedly exhibit internal-control weaknesses — the process-quality construct the span measures).

Ashbaugh-Skaife, H., Collins, D.W., Kinney, W.R. (2007), 'The Discovery and Reporting of Internal Control Deficiencies Prior to SOX', Journal of Accounting and Economics 44(1-2), 166-192 (correction and re-filing behavior as the visible trace of control deficiencies).

Ogneva, M., Subramanyam, K.R., Raghunandan, K. (2007), 'Internal Control Weakness and Cost of Equity', The Accounting Review 82(5), 1255-1297 (process weakness is priced persistently through required returns — the gradual-discount channel).
Givoly, D., Palmon, D. (1982), 'Timeliness of Annual Earnings Announcements: Some Empirical Evidence', The Accounting Review 57(3), 486-508 (disclosure timeliness carries information beyond content).

Chambers, A.E., Penman, S.H. (1984), 'Timeliness of Reporting and the Stock Price Reaction to Earnings Announcements', The Accounting Review 59(1), 21-47 (reporting-delay structure linked to return behavior — cited for the timeliness-return linkage; no timing-lane observable is used).
